title: Eriador Local Model Catalog (v1)
description: Canonical catalog of open-source LLMs. Every row in `models[]` describes one model — its family, size, per-tier hardware requirements, use cases, and (optionally) a Hugging Face GGUF pointer for direct download. Consumers fetch catalog.json, validate it against this schema, and render it as a model picker / recommendation UI. Fully public; no auth or credentials required to fetch.

schema_version.description: Semver of the catalog schema. Bump the MAJOR when a required field changes shape or a required field is added — consumers are expected to refuse a catalog whose major exceeds their supported max (currently 1).

_meta.description: Free-form catalog metadata. catalog_version is the field consumers surface as the version pill; bump on every published change.

catalog_version.description: Human-readable version stamp (e.g. "2026.07.09-1"). Bumped on every merge to main so ops can see at a glance whether a consumer is up to date. Convention: <YYYY.MM.DD>-<counter>.

schema_version.description: Redundant copy of the top-level schema_version — accepted here so older tooling that read it out of _meta keeps working.

last_updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent edit.

models.description: The curated model list. Every row appears in the Models page (subject to hardware bucketing) and can be selected as a chat default. Order determines default display order when no hardware filter is applied.

model_id.description: Stable per-model identifier. For Ollama rows: the pull ref (e.g. 'llama3.1:8b'). For llama.cpp rows: still a stable id — the real download source is the `gguf` block.

display_name.description: Human label rendered in cards and dropdowns.

family.description: Model family (llama, qwen, gemma, phi, deepseek, ...) — used for icons and group headers.

size_gb.description: Approx on-disk size for the recommended quantization (Q4_K_M for most rows).

min_ram_gb.description: Bare minimum RAM to load — will page heavily below this.

recommended_ram_gb.description: Comfortable inference RAM (fits the model + generous KV cache).

use_cases.description: Any of: chat, code, reasoning, embed, vision. Drives the use-case filter chips on the Models page.

notes.description: Free-form guidance shown beneath the card.

gguf.description: Optional Hugging Face GGUF pointer. Present = a local llama.cpp-style runtime can download this model directly from Hugging Face. Missing = the row is runtime-registry-only (e.g. Ollama pull ref only).

filename.description: Exact .gguf filename inside the repo, e.g. 'Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf'.

sha256.description: Hex digest for content-integrity verification. null until measured by scripts/verify-hf-urls.mjs against a pinned upstream version.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte count for progress + disk-check preflight. null until measured.
